channel.title: Chad - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Chad, every source cited.

item.title: Chad officials set strict rules for herders
item.description: Loug-Chari department secretary-general bans nomadic herders before December 15 to prevent farmer-herder clashes.

item.title: Chad teachers demand better pay and conditions
item.description: Teachers cite overcrowded classrooms, poor facilities, and unpaid bonuses as reasons for their dissatisfaction.

item.title: Chad health minister inspects dengue response in N'Djamena
item.description: Dr. Abdelmadjid Abderahim visited hospitals to check diagnostic kits and patient care amid a dengue outbreak.

item.title: Chad arrests 39 after deadly intercommunal clashes
item.description: Government ministers visited Ngoura after 25 people died and 22 were injured in violence between two communities.

item.title: Chad mourns writer Isaac Tédambé
item.description: The 72-year-old author of "République à vendre" was laid to rest in his home village.
